Apple beats estimates as services revenue hits record

Apple Inc reported quarterly revenue above Wall Street expectations on Monday, helped by a surge in services and wearables that offset a slowdown in iPhone sales.

The company said revenue rose 1% to 58.3 billion dollars in the quarter ended March 28, while earnings per share came in at 2.55 dollars, ahead of the 2.26 dollars consensus.

Shares rose about 4% in after-hours trading following the release.
